name: Ishmael
summary: Abraham's first son, born to Hagar, Sarai's Egyptian maid. God blessed him and promised to make him a great nation, the father of twelve princes.

key_moments.title: Named Before Birth
key_moments.description: The angel of the LORD told Hagar to name her son Ishmael, because the LORD had heard her trouble. Hagar bore Abram's son when Abram was 86.

key_moments.title: Promised to Become a Great Nation
key_moments.description: Abraham asked God to let Ishmael live before Him. God promised to bless Ishmael and make him the father of twelve princes, and Ishmael was circumcised at 13.

key_moments.title: Saved in the Wilderness
key_moments.description: Abraham sent the boy away with his mother Hagar, and their water ran out in the wilderness. God heard the boy's voice and showed Hagar a well, and the boy grew up in the wilderness of Paran.

key_moments.title: Burying His Father
key_moments.description: When Abraham died, his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah. Ishmael himself lived 137 years.
